prompt: Is this accessible enough to ship? Dark theme, lots of grey-on-grey, and the primary button is a mid-blue on near-black.
expected_output: A WCAG assessment that computes or demands contrast ratios and gives a ship/no-ship answer with specifics.
assertions: Names the specific WCAG criteria and thresholds at stake (e.g. 4.5:1 body, 3:1 large text and UI)
Asks for or computes actual contrast ratios rather than eyeballing
Covers more than contrast — focus order, focus visibility, target size
Gives a clear ship / do-not-ship verdict rather than hedging
